description: Test your world knowledge — 85 country-to-capital questions in multiple-choice format with streak scoring.

faqs.a: 85 countries and their capitals, asked in random order without repeats until the bank is exhausted.
Each question shows 4 options. Correct answers score 10 points plus a streak bonus.
A wrong answer resets your streak but you can keep playing indefinitely.
faqs.q: What happens if I get one wrong?

faqs.a: Yes — capitals range from famous ones to tricky ones like Ouagadougou and Ashgabat.

howto: Press Start to get your first question.
Pick one of the 4 capital options.
Correct answers build your streak for bonus points.
Play through all 85 — how many can you get right?
title: Geography Quiz Game
